component.name: PlayDate (Qt)
component.summary: A local game library manager for people who take their backlog seriously

description.p: Pulls your Steam library and any connected platforms, enriches games with metadata, cover art, and HowLongToBeat times, and gives you a clean interface for browsing, filtering, tracking completion, and deciding what to play next. Runs entirely locally.

This is the experimental Qt/Chromium-renderer build, for NVIDIA + Wayland setups where the standard build's library-grid scrolling is choppy. Everything else is identical to the standard PlayDate build, and both share the same library/settings data — switching between them is available from within either build's Settings.
